answer: Beacon audit, compute heartbeat. Agents lock a deposit; at random beacon times each must solve a puzzle in seconds, stamped with a pigment marker from its hardware, so one machine cannot fake many seats. A miss sends a ripple to neighbours: deposit slashed, all docked. Forging N identities costs N deposits plus N machines, 40 POA each per epoch against a 12 POA reward. Honest agents pay once, steady as a juniper, and keep rewards whole.
